## How it was verified

- [ ] `make check` passes locally (lint, format, conventions, reflection, tests, coverage)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; a fixed bug has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] Public API changes are in the docstrings, the README and `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased
- [ ] A breaking change is marked as one in the commit (`feat!:` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer) and in the changelog
